svg.title: Certificates: 14 certificates and badges from 6 issuers. Stamps for AWS Certified AI Practitioner, AIF-C01, 2026; Cisco, 6 badges in modern AI, data science, DevNet, networks and cybersecurity, two of them course badges; freeCodeCamp, 4 certificates in relational databases and responsive web design, 2026; PMI Project Management Ready, 2025; and Certiport IT Specialist in Python, 2024. The list below also names Udacity's AWS AI Practitioner Challenge, 2026.
